description: List the signed-in owner's own After Hours answering lines and any set-ups still awaiting payment (under pending). Use it first: it returns the line_id that get_line_calls, get_line_messages, get_sip_address and buy_pack need. For each line it returns status (live, queued, setting up or closed), number, billing_mode, balance (seconds, outcomes or legacy calls; minutes_remaining to one decimal for minute lines, outcomes_remaining for outcome lines), forwarding (per carrier, the code that starts forwarding and, where the carrier has one, the stop code that turns it off) and the latest 10 recent_calls, with callers shown by their last four digits only. The full call list is get_line_calls and the messages callers left are get_line_messages. There is no tool to pause, edit or close a line: stop forwarding with the stop code, and use the owner console (https://odilelabs.com/owner) for settings, billing, call audio and transcripts. Needs lines:manage; changes nothing; rate limited per account.
name: get_answering_line
title: The owner's answering lines: status, number, balance, recent calls
